meta.name: firebase-basics
meta.description: Provides foundational Firebase CLI setup, CLI installation, version checks (`firebase-tools@latest --version`), CLI login (including --no-localhost), project creation, project selection (`firebase use`), and app config file downloads (`google-services.json`, `GoogleService-Info.plist`). Use ONLY for CLI login, project creation/switching, or downloading app config files. Don't use for Firebase Hosting deploy, Firestore, Auth, App Hosting, Data Connect, Crashlytics, or Remote Config.

copy.tagline: 搭建 Firebase 开发环境,管理项目与配置文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚开始接触 Firebase,需要快速完成项目环境配置。
copy.tagline_en: Set up Firebase CLI, create projects, and download config files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to Firebase and need to configure your project environment quickly.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能使用 Firebase 的命令行工具检查版本、登录账号、创建或切换项目、下载安卓/iOS 的配置文件。它只处理这些基础配置，不负责部署、数据库等其他任务。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行 Firebase 登录、项目创建/切换、下载应用配置文件时，会触发该技能。

say.text: 帮我登录 Firebase 账号。
say.note: 会执行登录命令，可能需要浏览器授权。

say.text: 新建一个 Firebase 项目，ID 为 my-app。
say.note: 会执行创建命令，ID 需全局唯一且符合命名规则。

say.text: 下载当前项目的安卓配置文件 google-services.json。
say.note: 会通过命令行直接获取，不用去控制台下载。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Firebase CLI to check versions, log in, create/switch projects, and fetch Android/iOS config files. It only handles these basics, not deploys or databases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to log in to Firebase, create/switch a project, or download an app config file.

say_en.note: Runs the login command; may require browser authorization.

say_en.text: Create a new Firebase project with ID my-app.
say_en.note: Runs creation; ID must be globally unique.

say_en.text: Download the Android config file google-services.json for this project.
say_en.note: Fetches via CLI instead of the console.
